title_en: Infinity Festival Returns to Los Angeles This November, Promising to Explore How AI Is Reshaping the Future of Entertainment
summary_en: Infinity Festival returns to the Audrey Irmas Pavilion in Los Angeles this November for its 9th edition, featuring panels and programming focused on how AI is reshaping the entertainment industry.
body_en:
Infinity Festival, an annual event celebrating the convergence of entertainment, technology, and creativity, is returning to Los Angeles this November for its 9th edition. From November 12-15, the festival will be taking over the Audrey Irmas Pavilion for “four days of ideas, experiences, screenings, demonstrations, and conversations about what comes next.”
In previous years, the festival has hosted guests like Avengers directors the Russo Brothers, Brie Larson, Jon Favreau, Project Hail Mary directors Phil Lord and Chris Miller, Jeff Bridges, and many more. This year, the festival promises to dive deep into AI, with panels focusing on its “growing role across the creative industries.” Instead of a standalone track, AI will be present through a broader program “spanning animation, gaming, sports tech, filmmaking, music, virtual production, and live entertainment.”
At the event, AI-focused programming will “explore the evolving tools and workflows behind animation and filmmaking, the growing crossover between gaming and entertainment, new technologies reshaping live sports and fan experiences, as well as advances in immersive production and live event design.”
Additionally, longtime partners like NVIDIA and HP will participate in the festival’s 2026 programming slate, which will feature “panels, keynotes, screenings, demonstrations, and exhibitions, with speakers and programming to be announced in the coming weeks.”
“The changes happening across entertainment and technology aren’t taking place in separate lanes anymore, and Infinity Festival is built for that reality,” said Mark Lieber, Founder and CEO of Infinity Festival. “We’re thrilled to have NVIDIA, HP, and Intel return as presenting sponsors as we bring together the creative and technology communities shaping where these industries go next.”
For more information about Infinity Festival, check out www.infinityfestival.com .
